title: A Fire Upon the Deep
author: Vinge, Vernor
review:
Was sort of hoping for a bit more in either ideas, plot, or characters but there was some good stuff in here. Don't think I'm really chomping at the bit for the next book but maybe in time I will be.

Highlight of the book was probably the different alien races and the world building is very interesting and well thought out. The different zones is a really cool idea, wish it was utilitized a bit more but it made for a good justification for why the universe is set up the way it is.
